g.aria-label: WBS-MCP-20-04: Deliver an approved MCP authorization-server/token-service contract; Dependencies: `WBS-MCP-10-01`, `WBS-MCP-10-02`. ADR 0003 accepts DEC-MCP-03's bounded OAuth design only; ADR 0009 selects AS-owned database-backed same-commit atomicity and Zova-presented, AS-controlled browser grant-flow directions for design only. The first AS implementation targets SQLite via `better-sqlite3` on Vona's existing primary datasource; actual deployment confirmation, SQLite transition/migration proof, AS schema, site/admission and browser/session/CSRF implementation, delivery, applicable DEC-MCP-04 integration and execution approval remain independent authority gates, not satisfied by these planning predecessors.; Blocked
g.title: WBS-MCP-20-04: Deliver an approved MCP authorization-server/token-service contract; Dependencies: `WBS-MCP-10-01`, `WBS-MCP-10-02`.
